verdict: Paid ads are off; Google Business activity dropped sharply this week.
narrative: No paid advertising ran on Meta or Google in the last 28 days, meaning all measurable activity came from organic sources. Your Google Business Profile drove 148 actions this period — 63 calls, 56 direction requests, and 29 website clicks — but that activity dropped 50% in the most recent week, with the last three days recording near zero. Your contact management system shows 162 contacts and 10 opportunities created this period, though none have converted to closed patients; conversion tracking is being repaired, so that figure likely under-reports actual outcomes. We are reviewing Google Business Profile visibility and restarting paid campaigns to restore consistent lead flow before the end of the month.
